description: This file defines a 'NullFilter' class that inherits from 'FrameProcessor'. It functions as a filter that blocks all frames except system and end frames within a frame processing pipeline, primarily for testing or temporarily halting frame flow.

classes.name: NullFilter
classes.description: A filter that blocks all frames except system and end frames, inheriting from FrameProcessor.

methods.name: __init__(self, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the NullFilter with optional arguments, passing them to the parent FrameProcessor.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, only passing through system and end frames asynchronously.
